advisory.finding: The new typed OutboundUpdatePayload / OutboundDeletePayload branches in _mutation_to_batch_dict — which surface comments, labels, and links from the dataclass's own named attributes — are never exercised end-to-end through _mutation_to_batch_dict. scenarios: An outbound update with link adds is dispatched via the typed OutboundUpdatePayload path; a bug in the new branch drops links/comments/labels and the link is reported applied but never created in Jira (bug 3f04 recurrence).

The dict-fallback branch's create heuristic (top-level-spread strip of _BOOKKEEPING_KEYS) can silently mis-derive `fields` from an OutboundCreatePayload seen only as a Mapping.
dropped.finding: batch_dispatch._mutation_to_batch_dict's new `isinstance(mutation.payload, OutboundCreatePayload/OutboundUpdatePayload)` fast paths depend on cross-module class identity, but the package is routinely loaded both by-path and by ordinary package import. If outbound_pass.py resolves OutboundCreatePayload from one module object and batch_dispatch resolves it from another (dual-loaded under a different sys.modules key by a test/loader), the isinstance check silently misses and the typed payload falls through to the raw-dict heuristic branch — a fail-open normalization whose wrong output is indistinguishable from correct output.
